sources.snippet: This paper introduces Baku, a transformer architecture for efficient multi-task policy learning in robotics using offline imitation learning and advanced techniques.

sources.title: BAKU: An Efficient Transformer for Multi-Task Policy Learning
sources.snippet: In this work, we present BAKU, a simple transformer architecture that enables efficient learning of multi-task robot policies. BAKU builds upon recent advancements in offline imitation learning and meticulously combines observation trunks, action chunking, multi-sensory observations, and action heads to substantially improve upon prior work.
